name: SlashCommand

test_list.description: `/research status|report|resume` are sub-commands; other text starts research.
`/session resume` without a valid id is BadArg; with a UUID it parses.
`/usr/bin is broken` is prose, not a command.
Every catalog command parses to its variant, including arguments.
names::SLASH_COMMANDS equals the set of top-level arms of the parser match (source scan): completion menus cannot drift from the grammar.
Every listed /name parses to a command or an argument error, never UnknownCommand.
names::DIRECTIVES equals the set of typed directive arms (source scan).
Every listed $name types or fails with an argument error; never falls back to Custom.

output_description: ParsedInput.command set; no directives or mentions.
